title: Daily digest: Level 3 Elevated
message: Saudi Arabia shot down a Houthi missile over Riyadh on Saturday with no damage; no new confirmed attacks on US bases, tankers or Gulf oil sites since. Oil is near US$91 and SA fuel is steady. Elsewhere: Britain's pensions and benefits office confirmed a cyber attack (a hack, payments unaffected, attacker unknown), part of a run of big overseas hacks. Nothing needs doing.
